name: connector-informz
description: Higher Logic Thrive Marketing Professional (formerly Informz). Advanced API (AAPI): a single-door SOAP service whose one operation, PostInformzMessage, carries GridRequest (read) and ActionRequest (write) XML. 70 objects — subscribers with demographics and interests, mailings and instances, per-mailing activity (opens, clicks, bounces, opt-outs), campaigns, web tracking, scoring, target groups, suppression. In-body credentials plus IP allowlisting; offset paging capped at 1,000 rows.
